status: Source-informed protocol frozen before first production evaluation
tolerance_basis: Binary64 arithmetic allowance against 60-digit Decimal or exact Fraction references. Offset allowance covers input rounding and cancellation near RA wrap/poles. These are computational goals, not observational error bounds. Rounded constant checks use one half of the final stated decimal place; no empirical tuning.
numeric_domain: Finite positive parallax; finite magnitude. Positive finite masses/radii/axes in the frozen bounded grids. Missing, nonfinite and nonpositive required physical inputs give null. Gaia magnitude can be negative. The screen requires finite positive radius; temperature or insolation must be finite positive to count as present.
robustness_domain: Outside bounded grids, controlled ValueError or null is acceptable for unrepresentable positive results; OverflowError, ZeroDivisionError, nonfinite derived results and silent zero from intermediate overflow are not. Representable extreme reference values must agree or reject explicitly. Invalid sky coordinates must reject. This is an acceptance requirement, not a claim the legacy code enforces it.
trapezoid: Total duration is first-to-fourth contact; ingress fraction is each ramp divided by total duration. Positive finite depth up to 1000000 ppm, positive finite duration, 0<ingress_fraction<0.5, finite sample times. Greater-than-unit depth must reject. Finite valid model flux stays in [0,1]. No limb darkening, impact parameter, eccentric geometry, exposure integration, physical contact derivation or fit.
depth_physical_domain: The area-ratio formula requires planet radius no larger than stellar radius for the represented full-disk depth. Larger ratios must return null or controlled ValueError, not a depth greater than 1000000 ppm.
probability_domain: Circular isotropic-orientation geometry including grazing transits. Values capped at 100 percent are algebraic characterization outside an exterior orbit, not a valid embedded orbit or eccentric probability.
constant_conventions: Independently test the legacy depth conversion against 6371000 m volumetric mean Earth radius, probability conversion against IAU nominal 6378100 m equatorial radius, solar radius 695700000 m and au 149597870700 m. A separate common-Earth-radius coherence goal requires the two implied radii to agree within the sum of their half-final-digit rounding intervals. Neither radius is silently substituted for the other. Density 5.514 g/cm3 is a declared approximate legacy normalization; independent mass/volume sensitivity is diagnostic, not a physical calibration.
projection: Independent 3-D great-circle construction over 0.01,0.25,1,5,10 degree cones, both RA wrap locations and declinations -90,-85,-60,0,60,85,90. Decimal reference tests the stated equirectangular arithmetic. Difference from the geodesic spherical log map is a diagnostic, not a pass/fail angular-accuracy threshold or a continuous bound. Exact poles are allowed by the existing query API and retain coordinate convention dependence.
heuristic: Closed radius interval [0.5,2] Earth; closed temperature interval [180,310] K OR closed insolation interval [0.25,2] Earth. Boundary/OR/invalid handling only; no habitable-zone model, terrestrial composition inference, habitability probability or empirical calibration.
ingestion: Synthetic CSV only. Gaia explicit finite colour/SNR override fallbacks even when inconsistent. Nonfinite fields sanitize to missing. Exoplanet derived values are recalculated, not taken from pl_dens/pl_trandep; eccentricity is retained but not used by circular probability. Mass provenance, limits, joint-fit covariance, and reference metadata remain unqualified.
failure_policy: Retain every failed acceptance case. Default runner exits nonzero on scientific/contract failure. A separately named reproduction-audit mode may verify the entire frozen observation record, without changing failed goals. New failures or unexpected improvements fail the reproduction audit and require review. No tolerance relaxation or production correction in Mission 60.
independence: Generator uses only Python standard library and independent expressions, with production imports blocked in regeneration tests. Scalar algebra is high-precision arithmetic validation; no independent physical data or uncertainty calibration is claimed. Geometry uses an independently formulated spherical vector construction. Screen thresholds are declared product policy, not literature-derived science.
